name: California EV charger field test reliability metrics
description: California Energy Commission staff results for operational status, successful charge attempts, accessibility and initial-payment failures. Keeps the field-test scope separate from the federal per-port uptime calculation.

method.access: Exclude ports that could not be accessed from the operational and successful charge metrics.
method.operational_rate: Point-in-time result from plug-in tests and observations, with weighting described on printed page 6.
method.successful_charge_attempt_rate: Successful charges among operational ports in the plug-in tests. The test protocol allowed alternative payment options after an unsuccessful method.

federal_uptime.applies_to: Ports covered by the federal rule
federal_uptime.measurement: prior 12 months, calculated monthly using qualifying outage exclusions
